name: Eye-Tracking Position Adaptive Display (Parallax Barrier Variant)
definition: An autostereoscopic display using a parallax barrier with multiple parallel strip backlight sources, where an eye-tracking system determines viewer eye position to select appropriate light sources.
summary: An autostereoscopic display using a parallax barrier and parallel strip backlights that dynamically selects active sources based on real-time eye tracking to direct light to the viewer's eyes.
